name: RabbitMQ
description: Queue depth, consumers and dead letters. Community code, not reviewed.

x-card.description: Queue depth, consumers and dead letters. Community code, not reviewed.

host.title: Host
host.description: The RabbitMQ node that serves the management API, for example rabbit.acme.internal

port.title: Port
port.description: The management API. The plugin may reach only port 15672 of the host.

vhost.title: Virtual host
vhost.description: Every tool works in this virtual host only

user.title: User
user.description: Best a user tagged monitoring: it reads queues and consumers, and publishing needs write permission on the exchange.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: https:// to the management API. Without TLS the plugin reaches only a private address the environment's policy allows.

tools.name: rabbitmq_queues
tools.title: Queues
tools.description: The queues of the connection's virtual host, deepest first: messages ready and unacknowledged, consumers, state, type and where rejected messages go (the dead-letter exchange).

name.description: Only queues whose name contains this text

tools.name: rabbitmq_consumers
tools.title: Consumers
tools.description: Who consumes from the virtual host's queues: the queue, the consumer tag, the client connection and host, prefetch, manual or automatic acks and whether the consumer is active.

queue.description: Only the consumers of this queue

tools.name: rabbitmq_dead_letters
tools.title: Dead letters
tools.description: Where the virtual host's rejected and expired messages end up: each dead-letter queue with its depth and the queues that dead-letter into it, and the queues whose dead-letter exchange routes to no queue (those messages are lost). Reads counts only; no message is taken off a queue.

tools.name: rabbitmq_publish
tools.title: Publish a message
tools.description: Publishes one message to an exchange of the virtual host with a routing key (the default exchange delivers to the queue of that name). Waits for a person's approval; the answer says whether a queue took it.

exchange.description: The exchange; empty for the default exchange

routingKey.description: The routing key, or the queue's name on the default exchange

persistent.description: Delivery mode 2: the message survives a broker restart
